pamela-hunter.license: © New York State Assembly, used as a drawing reference
pamela-hunter.notes: Frame at 0:12.5 of the Assembly's own video on her member page ("Assemblymember Hunter speaks with Tyler Nims, Chief, Law Enforcement Misconduct Investigative Office, NYS Attorney General's Office during a public hearing examining the use of Automatic License Plate Reader Systems in New York," November 9, 2026), with the chyron "Hon. Pamela J. Hunter, (D) 128th A.D.". This is her current look; the clip's poster still (vidclips/20261109.jpg) has her looking down, so the frame was pulled from the video where she faces the camera. Front-facing, mouth slightly open mid-sentence; shoulder-length honey-brown curls, darker at the roots; bold rectangular glasses with red tops and black-and-white tortoiseshell rims; long drop earrings; patterned brown cardigan over a tan top; hands clasped below her chin, desk mic in front. Face ~260px across. Earlier sources: the June 10, 2025 press-conference still (video/26689, vidclips/20250610.jpg) shows long dark curls with caramel highlights and no glasses; the May 28, 2026 stills show braids; the Assembly directory headshot (member_files/128/headshot/128.jpg) is only 134x200 and dates from about 2015. No Commons photo exists.

catherine-nolan.license: © New York State Assembly, used as a drawing reference
catherine-nolan.notes: Re-sourced 2026-11-11 to replace a low-res Assembly floor-video still of her mid-word (member_files/037/vidclips/20180313a.jpg; now photos/catherine-nolan.candid.jpg). Phone photo, a little soft; face ~250px across. Drawn from a head-and-shoulders crop (x 10-660, y 330-1130). No posed headshot larger than the 134x200 directory photo exists, and no Commons photo.

Front-facing, warm smile showing teeth, round soft face, long dark hair in loose waves past the shoulders with a side-swept part, red lipstick, pearl necklace and stud earrings, royal blue double-breasted blazer over a white top, US and Virginia flags behind. Face ~490px across. The original is a three-quarter-length shot with a small head, so the working copy photos/jennifer-carroll-foy.jpg is cropped to head and shoulders (box 244,100,1544,1500 of the original; 1300x1400); the full file is photos/jennifer-carroll-foy.full.jpg.

margaret-chin.license: © Margaret Chin campaign, used as a drawing reference

zohran-mamdani.official.license: © City of New York, used as a drawing reference

Face ~300px across. Alternatives: Commons File:Zohran_Jul_21,_2026.jpg (NYC Mayor's Office, CC BY 4.0, 1200x1601, a frame from the office's YouTube video 8ZuV5L0QL04) and File:Zohran_Mamdani_at_The_White_House_(portrait).jpg (White House, public domain, 552x943, Nov 2025).

andrew-cuomo.publisher: Wikimedia Commons (Metropolitan Transportation Authority; photo: Patrick Cashin / MTA)
andrew-cuomo.notes: Re-sourced 2026-11-11 to replace a low-res, mid-word briefing-table candid (governor's office Flickr 51395017921, 2021-08-22; now photos/andrew-cuomo.candid.jpg). Taken 2017-01-01 at the Second Avenue Subway opening ride, while governor; cropped on Commons from File:Second_Avenue_Subway_first_ride_96th_St_(31192356394).jpg (1920x1578, the largest available). Near front-facing with the head turned slightly to his left, broad smile showing teeth; dark-brown swept-back hair, dark suit, white shirt, light blue tie, round lapel pin; subway car behind.
